sentences.text: After hearing learned counsel for the parties, this Court is of the opinion that it is a fit case to suspend the remaining part of the jail sentence of the appellant and to release him on bail.

It is directed that on depositing of fine amount, if not already 3 CRA-11936-2022 deposited and on furnishing personal bond to the tune of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees fifty thousand only) with two sureties in the like amount to the satisfaction of the Trial Court for his appearance before the Trial Court on 06.10.2025 and on all subsequent dates as may be fixed by the concerned Court, the execution of remaining part of the jail sentence of Sanjay @ Sanju Jhariya shall remain suspended and he be released on bail till final disposal of this appeal.
List for final hearing in due course.
